name: Bulk View Renamer
summary: Renames the views of the View Map or the Project Map, or of one folder, in one go: find and replace, prefix and suffix, or a pattern with a counter.

versions.changelog: A Map choice: works on the View Map or on the Project Map, with the same folders that open and close. In the Project Map the sections, elevations, interior elevations, details and worksheets are renamed; the other viewpoints are listed as cannot rename.

Shows the views in the View Map's folders, which open and close, with a Type column, and a Type choice that lists only one type of view (floor plan, section, elevation, schedule, ...). Selecting a folder selects its views.
First version in the marketplace, the same as the built-in script of the same name.
